acquisition.bodyInterpretation: Nine complete HTML bodies and one complete image-only PDF saved. USTC legacy route redirects to a news index. WTU PDF has no substantive text layer and was fully rendered offline; relevant award tables were visually inspected. No landing, list, month-only interval, enrollment/start boundary or stored date is treated as exact applicant-cutoff proof.

rules: Source-only date evidence; no canonical date, status, publication or whole-record freshness changes.
Unknown exact dates remain unknown; year-round applications do not produce a synthetic deadline.
Programme semester dates, latest study-start dates, registration dates and award result dates are not applicant cutoffs.
Month-only ranges are not expanded into month-end ISO days. Independent award routes keep their own scope.
USTC stored 2026-02-15 is preserved but not reverified because the registered source now redirects to an unrelated news index.
WHU multi-school provincial award is assessed only under the queue-attributed university; no other institution is covered.
Only one direct-linked recovery per incomplete original source; unresolved groups enter cooldown. No permanent programme cessation is inferred.

summary.en: USTC confirms a full scholarship for the designated Scientific Management Leaders MBA. The 2026 university and CSC stages are closed; no later cycle is inferred.

summary.ru: USTC подтверждает полную стипендию для MBA «Лидеры научного управления»; этапы университета и CSC 2026 года закрыты, следующий цикл не предполагается.

notes.en: USTC officially offers this English-taught MBA to eligible non-Chinese professionals through a two-year 1+1 model. The university-stage deadline of 15 February 2026 is closed; the program carries a full scholarship.
notes.zh: 中国科学技术大学官方面向符合条件的非中国籍职业人士开设该英文MBA，采用两年“1+1”培养模式；校内申请截止2026年2月15日，现已关闭，并配套全额奖学金。
notes.ru: USTC официально предлагает эту англоязычную MBA-программу подходящим иностранным специалистам по двухлетней модели 1+1; срок университета 15 февраля 2026 года закрыт, предусмотрена полная стипендия.

groups.yearTitle: China Link Short-term Scientific Exchange Scholarship Program （2026）
groups.applicantPeriodQuote: The CSC application portal is open to applicants all year round.
groups.studyStartQuote: Start study in China no later than August 31, 2027.

notes.en: First email admission@wzu.edu.cn with the subject “China Link + Name + university name” to obtain admission eligibility or pre-admission, then submit CSC Type B (agency number 10351). Applications are rolling and study must begin no later than August 31, 2027.
notes.zh: 须先邮件联系admission@wzu.edu.cn（主题“China Link + 姓名 + 所在大学”）取得入学资格或预录取，再提交CSC Type B申请（受理机构编号10351）。全年滚动申请，最晚于2027年8月31日前开始学习。
notes.ru: Сначала напишите на admission@wzu.edu.cn с темой «China Link + имя + университет» для подтверждения права на приём, затем подайте CSC Type B (код 10351). Начало обучения — не позднее 31 августа 2027 года.

name.ru: Стипендия China Link в Вэньчжоуский университет

summary.en: Full funding covers tuition, on-campus accommodation and insurance. The monthly allowance is CNY 3,000 for general scholars and CNY 3,500 for senior scholars. A Wenzhou University pre-admission or invitation is required before the CSC submission.
summary.zh: 全额资助覆盖学费、校内住宿和保险；普通进修生生活费为每月3,000元，高级进修生为每月3,500元。提交CSC申请前须先取得温州大学预录取或邀请材料。
summary.ru: Полное финансирование покрывает обучение, общежитие и страховку; выплата составляет 3 000 юаней для обычных и 3 500 юаней для старших стажёров. До подачи в CSC требуется предварительное зачисление или приглашение Вэньчжоуского университета.
